abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.
